name: lone-star-clinic
description: Repo-level tooling: end-to-end tests, type generation and dev shortcuts.

scripts.gen:types: cd backend && .venv/bin/python -m app.export_openapi > ../frontend/openapi.json && cd .. && openapi-typescript frontend/openapi.json -o frontend/src/api/schema.d.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && tsc -p e2e
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run format:check && cd backend && .venv/bin/ruff check . && .venv/bin/ruff format --check .
